## Product sticker rasters

M5Stack product sticker PNGs are included with the provider's permission for public distribution. The artwork, product marks and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners; the project MIT license applies to project-authored code and does not relicense these images or marks. The input table, private source mappings, vector originals and vector conversion intermediates are excluded from the repository and builds.

Some additional printed surfaces are recreated from exact-model official photographs with the user's authorization. These PNGs are identified at runtime as `reference-redraw`, and their public reference photographs and appearance estimates are documented in each product's `artwork-redraw.md`. They are not manufacturer vector originals or evidence of electrical pin compatibility. No photograph pixels, font files, drawing generators or intermediate design files are included. Product marks and trademarks retain their respective owners' rights.

## 2026-10-28 controller families

The own C123 AtomS3 and K130 Dial native structure data and K001-V27 Basic frame/buttons derive from M5Stack/M5_Hardware at commit `e29c139cbc7c80b5ccc5557e5ab8025a7a19a109` (MIT). Per-product source ledgers and license copies are retained in their device/research directories. The Plus2 and replacement Basic rear assembly are original visual reconstructions with inferred concealed dimensions. Approved ordinary PNGs and identified photograph-based redraws retain their respective image/trademark rights; this does not distribute private sticker tables, vectors or source mappings.


## Atom / Stick complete series additions (2026-10-28)

Each exact-SKU native CAD contribution is fixed to the M5_Hardware commit in its product research record and retains the M5Stack MIT notice and original source face attributes. Shared CAD blobs are explicitly identified;electronics and printing are independently sourced. Exact named Atom Voice Base kits retain their own native base geometry alongside the corresponding actual controller implementation.

Original reconstruction code and checks use this repository's MIT license. Approved ordinary raster artwork and official-reference redraws are recorded per product;image and trademark rights remain separate from code. Private tables,vector sources,raw source names/URLs/mappings and converters are excluded from the distribution tree.
